subject: pri-vt-td
title: PRI.VT.TD.------MOT.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 350 (PMBA-14). PRI-VT-TD (principle vibrational tendencies) is the subject; MOT-DY is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation), ATTN (attraction) and INFO-DY. From TR: PART (participation). From PART: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From ATTN: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From COS-P: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From WO-EXP-PRI: SF-RZ (self-realization). From INFO-DY: IST-F (isolated focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From IST-F: APL-DT (application dictates).
